text: Jahoda — Hello: Hey, nice to meet you. If you've got a commission, spit it out. As long as the pay's right, I can help you with anything... Uh, most things... I can help you with most things.
Jahoda — Chat: [[Nefer]]: Ugh... Boss Nef, when can I get a raise? There's so much stuff I wanna buy...
Jahoda — Chat: Walking the Streets: Come on, let's hit the town. I'll show you someplace fun... But keep it quiet, yeah? Mum's the word.
Jahoda — Chat: [[Ashru]]: Last time I tried to pet Ashru, the little fluffball ran away. Hmph! Someone's not getting their dried fish today!
Jahoda — When It Rains: Rain? Gogogo, we gotta find some cover before we get soaked.
Jahoda — When It Snows: Waaah! Snow down my back, coldcoldcold...
Jahoda — In the Desert: *Pfft!* *Pfft!* *Pfft!* Ugh, sand in my mouth!
Jahoda — Good Morning: Morning. Have breakfast yet? I know a good place.
Jahoda — Good Afternoon: *yawn* How about we head back to the shop for a nap? I'm so sleepy...
Jahoda — Good Evening: It's that late already? Pack it up, worktime's over, it's Ashru time~
Jahoda — Good Night: *yawn* Better hit the sack... Hey! You still at it? You should probably call it a night, too.
Jahoda — About Jahoda: Experience: Before I came to the Curatorium of Secrets, my work history was... checkered. Finally meeting Boss Nef after barely scraping by was a real turning point.
Jahoda — About Jahoda: Curatorium of Secrets: Boss Nef's good to me, and Ashru's pretty friendly, too. Sometimes I forget to call Nef "Boss." Old habits die hard, I guess...
Jahoda — About Us: Homeland: My hometown? Don't remember... and I don't really care about that kinda thing anyway. Anywhere I can have a full belly and a good night's sleep is "home" enough for me.
Jahoda — About Us: Friends: We've been through hell and back together, of course we're friends! Next time I'm in trouble, I know [[Traveler
Jahoda — About the [[Vision]]: Hehe, it's my pride and joy! Ever since I got it, work's been way less stress! Never imagined I'd ever be this lucky...

Jahoda — Something to Share: Treasure Hunters: You ever run into anyone calling themselves a "treasure hunter"? Don't let the fancy title fool you, they're just Nod-Krai mercenaries. Give 'em enough money and they'll do pretty much anything for you. If you ever wanna hire some, let me know. I can introduce you to a few of the more reliable ones.

Jahoda — Something to Share: Cannon: When the Boom and Blast Kuuvahki Energy Cannon gets going, it's a thing of beauty. *sigh* If only I could get my hands on a scale mechanical model... Wonder if Aino could make one for me? After all, she made the original.

Jahoda — Interesting Things: So, yesterday, I was just thinking... How many grains of sand does it take to make a pile? Is a hundred a pile? What about a thousand? Doesn't seem right... I'll go ask Aino in a few days, she definitely knows!

Jahoda — About [[Lauma]]: Miss Lauma? Uhm... I don't really know too much about her, but I know she's kind of a big deal, and she's powerful... and she can talk to animals... Thinking about it, she must have eyes and furry little ears all over Hiisi Island. No wonder treasure hunters don't go "looking for treasure" there, you'd be walking straight into a trap...

Jahoda — About [[Ineffa]]: Oh, that dumb clanker? She's good at baking krumkakes, but she's got a memory like a leaky sieve and zero humor. Every time I crack a joke she asks me to explain why it's funny. But her krumkakes are the bomb, you have got to try them.

Jahoda — About Nefer: Nef's the best boss in the whole world! Hehe, not only does she pay me on time, she even covers food and board! I might be her only actual employee... No, wait, I almost forgot about Ashru! Though he's not exactly an employee, right? He's never even completed a single commission! Hmph! Can't have anyone freeloading... Next job, he's coming with me!

Jahoda — About Aino: Aino's got some serious skills. No matter what I put my arm through, she always gets it working again. It's just... every time she fixes it, she always doodles on it. Says it's cuter that way. I mean, it is kinda cute, but why doesn't she ever draw on Ineffa?

Jahoda — About [[Flins]]: I've heard Nef talk about how the Lightkeepers are a really old organization, chock full of powerful, smart people who know tons of ancient secrets. Say... You think Flins has any leads on ancient treasures? Or maybe some untouched old ruins? Uh, I'm just thinking out loud here, I'd never actually ask! Otherwise, Nef'd chew me out again.

Jahoda — About [[Varka]]: Ohh, Varka? Yeah, he told me he was the Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, but seriously, he sure doesn't seem like it. Shouldn't a Grand Master be all serious and dependable-looking? Uh, not trying to say he's not responsible! It's just... If the Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius is here, then who's back in Mondstadt actually managing the Knights...? Eh? [[Jean

Jahoda — About [[Kuutar]]: That VIP... *sigh* Back in the day, if I came across someone with a background that murky, I'd have run for the hills! The farther the better! But... she saved me, so now I owe her, and debts are debts.Still, that's easy to say, but I've only got one life to lose, and at this rate, no amount of lives would be enough to cover the tab... O Boss Nef! Save me, you're my only hope...

Jahoda — About [[Marionette]]: I'm never going anywhere like that ever again! And... Okay, even if I did, Boss Nef would have to go with me. Between the Wild Hunt and Fatui... what's the point of making money if you're not alive to spend it!?

Jahoda — More About Jahoda: I: At the Curatorium, Nef handles the big stuff, I take the small stuff, and Ashru's on door duty. What counts as big and what doesn't? That's up to Boss Nef, she calls the shots...
Jahoda — More About Jahoda: II: Earn well, eat well, that's my motto these days. Point is, as long as I stick with Nef, I know I won't go hungry, hehehe...
Jahoda — More About Jahoda: III: My arm? Ah, that... no big deal. It was just the "price" I paid in a trade. Don't worry, it's fine! It was well worth it. In fact, I'd say I came out ahead.

Jahoda — More About Jahoda: IV: It's no different than how you gotta use Mora to buy stuff. If you want something, you have to pay some kind of "price." Visible prices you can plan for, calculate, but some of the invisible ones are impossible to gauge. They lurk in your shadow, biding their time, waiting until you're at your most vulnerable... that's when they appear, demanding a ransom from you that you could never hope to pay.

Jahoda — More About Jahoda: V: Hey, if you ever need to pay a "ransom" for some reason, you can come to me. Even if I can't drum up the money myself, I can swallow my pride and ask Nef. Worst comes to worst... I'll work off the debt again. But don't you dare ask Nef yourself. If you're gonna owe someone, better it be me. The hardest debt to repay is a debt in Nef's ledger... How do I know that? Uh, well, I, um... Look, don't ask, just take my word for it, okay!?

Jahoda — Jahoda's Hobbies: Sometimes, I sew rag dolls when I've got some downtime. I've had formal lessons from a teacher or anything, but my old... acquaintances all said I was pretty good. I'll make you one next time.

Jahoda — Jahoda's Troubles: I dunno why, but I can't sleep if the bed's too soft. Give me a rock-hard floor to lie on, and not only am I out like a light, I sleep like a baby! Wonder why that is? Just one of those things, I guess...
Jahoda — Favorite Food: Favorite food? Tough call... I like meat and fish, but sugar sculptures and cookies are great too... Hehe, as long as it's tasty, I'm all for it!

Jahoda — Least Favorite Food: I don't like those thick stews where all the ingredients are thrown in together and boiled forever, until it's all melted into mush... Uh, if I absolutely have to have some, it's not like I can't, it's just... I'd really rather not...
Jahoda — Receiving a Gift: I: YUM! Wow, since when can you cook like this? Seconds, please, hehehe. This is so much better than Nef's... *cough*! Uh, you eat already? If not... wanna share?
Jahoda — Receiving a Gift: II: Not bad! Hehe. Let's chow down! Gotta fuel up for work.
Jahoda — Receiving a Gift: III: Ugh... I can— I can finish this... Must... not... waste... food. Haha... ha...

Jahoda — Birthday: Happy birthday! Here ya go, this doll's for you! I just finished sewing it. It was my first time trying this technique — took ages, you know! I stuffed it with calming herbs that'll help you sleep, so just put it next to your pillow and I promise you'll sleep nice and soundly, 100% nightmare-free. The bandage on my hand...? Ah... just a little scratch from... playing with Ashru, hahaha... It's nothing, really...
Jahoda — Feelings About Ascension: Intro: Oh? Not bad at all!
Jahoda — Feelings About Ascension: Building Up: Nimbler than ever.
Jahoda — Feelings About Ascension: Climax: Alright... Time to get moving!
Jahoda — Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion: Hehe, I'm feeling ready for a big job now... How 'bout it? You wanna join me? }}
